# @vllnt/convex-progression

> XP, levels, and streak windows as a Convex component

`@vllnt/convex-progression` is a publishable Convex component. It targets `convex@^1.45.0`.
It stores one sandboxed table — `progress` (one row per `(scope, subjectRef, key)`: `xp`, `level`,
`streak`, `maxStreak`, `lastPeriodKey`). `accrue` adds XP; `level` is the count of host-supplied
`thresholds` that XP has reached. `recordActivity` takes a host `periodKey` and optional
`expectedPrevious` (same period is a no-op; match continues the streak; a gap resets to 1).
`get` can recompute `level` when the host passes `thresholds`. `eraseSubject` deletes in bounded
batches. The host owns auth, `subjectRef`, `key`, `delta`, and `thresholds` (never take those from
the end-user). Distinct from `@vllnt/convex-wallet` (balances) and `@vllnt/convex-quota` (resetting
caps).
